crossRefs.note: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
“Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring…
Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were…
This is the thing that you must do. A third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

translations.web: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
translations.bsb: If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened, more strength must be exerted, but skill produces success.
translations.kjv: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
translations.asv: If the iron be blunt, and one do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
